description: This file defines an abstract class DBManager which provides a database abstraction layer and core database management functionalities for SuiteCRM. It includes methods for creating, modifying, repairing, and dropping tables, indexes, and columns, as well as executing queries and handling errors. The class acts as a base driver for specific database implementations and manages database schema synchronization, query execution, and result handling.

classes.name: DBManager
classes.description: An abstract base class providing a database abstraction layer for SuiteCRM, with methods for managing database schema, executing queries, and error handling.

classes.name: DBManager
classes.description: This abstract class provides a wide range of database management functionalities such as executing queries, generating schema SQL, managing auto-increment fields, handling schema validation, and auditing data changes. It acts as a foundation layer for specific database implementations, interacting with SugarBean objects to perform schema operations aligned with bean definitions. It also offers utility functions for naming, data escaping, and type handling.
